mapper.select: select count(1) count from parking_space_machine_rel t left join parking_space ps on t.ps_id = ps.ps_id and ps.status_cd = '0' left join parking_area pa on ps.pa_id = pa.pa_id and pa.status_cd = '0' where t.status_cd = '0' and t.car_num = #{carNum} and pa.pa_id = #{paId}

select pa.num areaNum,ps.num psNum,t.car_num carNum,t.image_photo imagePhoto,t.update_time updateTime,t.ps_id psId from parking_space_machine_rel t left join parking_space ps on t.ps_id = ps.ps_id and ps.status_cd = '0' left join parking_area pa on ps.pa_id = pa.pa_id and pa.status_cd = '0' where t.status_cd = '0' and t.car_num = #{carNum} and pa.pa_id = #{paId}
